title: 'Safety Theatre': Anthropic CEO's Attack On OpenAI Comes As 1.5 Million Users Leave ChatGPT | Economy News - News18
text: The spat between Anthropic co-founder and CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI’s Sam Altman has surfaced after the former calls OpenAI’s dealing with the Department of Defense as “safety theater". According to a report by the Information citing the internal memo, Amodei said to staff that OpenAI is ‘placating’ employees while Anthropic cared about preventing abuses. “The main reason [OpenAI] accepted [the DoD’s deal] and we did not is that they cared about placating employees, and we actually cared about preventing abuses," Amodei wrote. Altman has come under fire in the US after calling the deal with the Defence department ‘looked opportunistic and sloppy’. Eventually, a boycott trend has emerged where users are quitting ChatGPT as a protest against OpenAI’s company deal to let the US Department of Defense use its AI models on a classified government network. According to websites tracking boycott pledge, more than 1.5 million users have left ChatGPT in less than 48 hours. Earlier, Anthropic and the US Department of Defense (DoD) failed to come to an agreement over the military’s request for unrestricted access to the AI company’s technology. Anthropic was insisting DoD to not use the company’s AI to enable domestic mass surveillance or autonomous weaponry. Anthropic has already sealed a 200 US dollar deal with DoD. In a letter to staff, Amodei refers to OpenAI’s messaging as “straight up lies," stating that Altman is falsely “presenting himself as a peacemaker and dealmaker."
